findings.evidence: Cluster tables now leave `handleCols` nil in `buildDataSource` (skip ExtraHandleID path) but still push it into `handleHelper`: `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:4640`, `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:4674`, `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:4675`. `LogicalLock.PruneColumns` assumes every `util.HandleCols` is non-nil and unconditionally calls `col.IterColumns()` -> panic when `col` is nil: `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_lock.go:67`. The same nil will also panic in physical planning (`col.ResolveIndices`): `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_lock.go:107` and at runtime (`col.BuildHandle`): `pkg/executor/select.go:263`. Second confirmation that cluster tables like `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TIFLASH_REPLICA` have no PK/common handle set (so `handleCols` can indeed be nil): only `CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY` sets `PKIsHandle`/`IsCommonHandle` in infoschema meta builder `pkg/infoschema/tables.go:423`, and `tableTableTiFlashReplicaCols` has no `PriKey` flags `pkg/infoschema/tables.go:1219`.
findings.fix: Avoid storing a nil `util.HandleCols` element in `handleHelper` for tables without handles. Minimal: only add `handleMap[tableInfo.ID] = []util.HandleCols{handleCols}` when `handleCols != nil`; otherwise omit the entry (or store an empty slice). For stronger correctness, explicitly reject or ignore `FOR UPDATE/SHARE` on cluster tables (since they have no KV row handles) rather than building a lock plan.
findings.impact: Blocker: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE/SHARE` involving cluster tables (e.g. `information_schema.tiflash_replica`) can panic during optimization (column pruning) or later in physical planning / execution due to nil method calls on `util.HandleCols`. This is a server-side stability issue (panic) and a potential DoS vector via crafted SQL.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd): the same `handleMap[tableInfo.ID] = []util.HandleCols{handleCols}` pattern remains in `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go`, and `LogicalLock.PruneColumns` / `PhysicalLock.ResolveIndices` still lack nil-guards, so this issue does not appear fixed later.
findings.verify:
Run planning-only and runtime paths for locking on a cluster table and ensure no panic:
- `EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TIFLASH_REPLICA FOR UPDATE;`
- `BEGIN; SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TIFLASH_REPLICA FOR UPDATE; ROLLBACK;`
Also re-check the original regression still works:
- `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TIFLASH_REPLICA);` and with a predicate.
findings.what: Cluster tables can now have `HandleCols == nil`, but the planner still records this nil handle in `handleHelper` as a `[]util.HandleCols{nil}` entry. `LogicalLock`/`PhysicalLock`/`SelectLockExec` assume handle entries are non-nil, so `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE/SHARE` on cluster tables can panic.

subject: planner: fix EXISTS subquery on cluster tables causing Column ID -1 (#65544)
summary: The core fix correctly avoids adding ExtraHandleID/ExtraCommitTSID for cluster tables and adds fallbacks to pick a real column, addressing the reported `Column ID -1` error in EXISTS queries. However, leaving cluster-table `HandleCols` as nil while still pushing it into `handleHelper` introduces a nil `util.HandleCols` entry that can panic in `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE/SHARE` paths (LogicalLock/PhysicalLock/SelectLockExec), and this remains unfixed up to `upstream/master`.
